summary: Betta persephone is a dark-coloured wild fighting fish recorded from shallow peat-swamp pools in Johor. Its Malaysian populations depend on a very restricted habitat. Older accounts describe it as Johor-endemic, but recent genetic research questions the distinction from the Bintan fish Betta miniopinna, so its broader range needs careful interpretation.
nativeRange: Johor peat swamps in Peninsular Malaysia; the relationship to Bintan populations remains a taxonomic issue.

features: Dark body without a conspicuous lateral blotch
Pale tips on the slender pelvic fins
Greenish iridescence on the unpaired fins

habitat.description: Shallow shaded pools among submerged leaf litter.
